title: Nadira
_note: PRO_01, PRO_04, PRO_06. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

morning.speaker: Nadira
morning.text: He lives. Come eat before the goats do it for you.

choices.spoken: Morning. You've been up for hours.

choices.text: [Dry] Is that bread or a brick?
choices.spoken: Is that bread, or did you build a wall?

bread.speaker: Nadira
bread.text: Brick, wall, whatever it is. Eat it.

chores.speaker: Nadira
chores.text: Water from the well. The goats fed. And the north fence is down again. Something dragged it in the night. The nails are in the tool box.

busy.speaker: Nadira
busy.text: The goats won't feed themselves. Well. They would. Everything we own.

report.speaker: Nadira
report.text: All done? And the fence? Good. Now take the cheese and the eggs to Saltreach before the heat. Lamp oil, and a bolt of cloth if Dalia has the teal. Here, the purse. And say hello to Zeyna for me.

choices.spoken: Save me the end. The burnt end.

market.speaker: Nadira
market.text: Cheese, oil, cloth. Teal, not the brown. And don't let Amira talk you into a sweet roll, you'll come home with six.

bundle.speaker: Nadira
bundle.text: You're home. Did you see Zeyna?

choices.text: [Give] She sent this. She said the weather is changing.
choices.spoken: She sent this for you. She said to tell you the weather is changing.

note.speaker: Nadira
note.text: [She unties the string, reads the scrap of paper inside, and folds it very small.] Did she. Well. She's always been good with weather.

secret.speaker: Nadira
secret.text: Can I ask you something stupid? If I had a secret, a bad one, from before you... would you hate me for it?

choices.spoken: Depends on the secret. But I'd stay.
Is this about the goat? I told you, it was already dead.
We've all got one. Come to bed.

goat.speaker: Nadira
goat.text: [She laughs, and the moment passes.] It was not already dead. It was asleep. Go and tell your daughter her story.

choices.text: Who is Zeyna to you, really?

zeyna.speaker: Nadira
zeyna.text: The oldest friend I have. Older than you. She knew me when I was small and frightened of everything. Go on. Tavi's waiting.

evening.speaker: Nadira
evening.text: Go and tell Tavi her story, before she tells it to herself and gets it right.

day2.speaker: Nadira
day2.text: Both hands. I mean it. And bring the dog back, he's the only one of you with any sense.

guest.speaker: Nadira
guest.text: [Very quietly.] Not now. Sit down. Be nice to him.

night.speaker: Nadira
night.text: Don't. I don't want to talk about him. Come to bed. Please.

idle.speaker: Nadira
idle.text: Go on. I'll still be here.
